payload.name: preserve-original-event-on-update
payload.description: Use during CRUD when an UPDATE or enrichment targets an existing memory whose subject or core claim differs from the new message; before overwriting, verify the new information is truly a revision of the same event, otherwise ADD a new memory and leave the original intact.
content: Before applying an UPDATE to an existing memory, compare the new message's event or state with the memory's existing core claim (subject, action, object, time).

If the new message describes a different event, activity, or state that does not directly revise or supersede the original claim, do not overwrite the existing memory; instead ADD a new memory for the new information.
When an UPDATE is appropriate, preserve all still-true factual details from the earlier version and only modify fields that the new evidence actually changes.

solves: When an UPDATE or enrichment to an existing memory would replace its core event with a different event from a later message, the earlier facts are destroyed. The failure is treating a memory as a mutable container rather than a record of one specific occurrence. Apply when a later message describes a distinct activity or state that does not supersede the original memory's subject; do not apply when the later message genuinely revises or extends the same event.
